title: Asymptotic Invariance of Kelly Allocation Under Power-Law Asset Dynamics: Evidence from Bitcoin
abstract: arXiv:2609.22612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We examine log-optimal portfolio allocation when the long-run price of an asset follows a power-law trajectory, $P(t)=At^\alpha$, and its instantaneous return variance decays as $\sigma^2(t)=\sigma_0^2 t^{-2\gamma}$. Under a zero risk-free-rate benchmark, the continuous-time Kelly fraction scales as $K^\ast(t)=(\alpha/\sigma_0^2)t^{2\gamma-1}$. Exact temporal invariance therefore occurs when $\gamma=1/2$, whereas deviations from this value produce systematic age dependence in the allocation. We propose a scaling hypothesis connecting growth in network participation, effective market liquidity, and declining volatility. Under a specified set of scaling assumptions, this model predicts the benchmark exponent $\gamma=1/2$. Using historical daily Bitcoin prices, we estimate the power-law price exponent and examine the sensitivity of the volatility exponent to the length of the rolling window. translated_title: 幂律资产动态下Kelly配置的渐近不变性：来自比特币的证据
translated_abstract: 我们研究了当资产的长期价格遵循幂律轨迹 $P(t)=At^\alpha$、且其瞬时收益方差按 $\sigma^2(t)=\sigma_0^2 t^{-2\gamma}$ 衰减时的对数最优投资组合配置问题。在零无风险利率基准下，连续时间Kelly比例满足标度关系 $K^\ast(t)=(\alpha/\sigma_0^2)t^{2\gamma-1}$。因此，当 $\gamma=1/2$ 时出现精确的时间不变性，而偏离该值会使配置产生系统性的资产年龄依赖性。我们提出了一个将网络参与度增长、有效市场流动性与波动率下降联系起来的标度假说。在一组给定的标度假设下，该模型预测出基准指数 $\gamma=1/2$。利用比特币历史日线价格数据，我们估计了幂律价格指数，并检验了波动率指数对滚动窗口长度的敏感性。对于四到九年的窗口，估计……
tldr: 本文证明当资产价格呈幂律增长且波动率按 $t^{-2\gamma}$ 衰减时，连续时间Kelly配置比例恰在波动率衰减指数 $\gamma=1/2$ 时具有时间不变性，并通过网络参与度与流动性增长的标度假说及比特币实证数据支持该基准指数。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that under power-law price growth and volatility decaying as t^{-2γ}, the continuous-time Kelly allocation fraction is exactly time-invariant when γ=1/2, and supports this benchmark exponent through a scaling hypothesis linking network participation and liquidity growth with Bitcoin empirical data.
